note: REPORT ONLY. None of these instruments can pass or fail a release, and none is a live score.

catalogue_hide_and_recover.ci: Wilson 95% computed per file in registry/build_report_*.json
catalogue_hide_and_recover.caveat: Every newly placed dot has d_cat >= 3.0 px by construction, so hide-and-recover cannot credit newly placed dots and only registers the untouched near-collar dots (constant 0.0384 across all SPACING variants because SPACING locks d_cat < 3.0 dots and only respaces d_cat >= 3.0 corridors).

sgmc_control.source: USGS State Geologic Map Compilation (Horton et al., 2017, https://doi.org/10.3133/ds1052, public domain)
sgmc_control.caveat: 1:500k bedrock SGMC faults are mostly pre-Quaternary structures; upstream SGMC-only submissions scored 0.0492-0.0512 live. Reported strictly as a structural sanity control (all H19-supported variants sit ~1.29x above random null on surrogate DTI); never used as a gate or target.

block_density_cv.definition_1km: 1 km x 1 km blocks (10 x 10 px), density = dots / footprint px, blocks with >=50% footprint
block_density_cv.definition_5km: 5 km x 5 km blocks (50 x 50 px), density = dots / footprint px, blocks with >=50% footprint
